searchText: The overhead of Merkle Trie generation is absolutely something to be concerned about. Right now it is a top performance concern for multiple clients. If done from a block witness most of the performance issues subside. (assuming said witness also has an output witness) I'm measuring now how much the CREATE costs should be bumped to cover the overhead. For the hexary trie seems to be between 0-60k gas (60k for 24k contract size) So you're right, it's significant enough to warrant a cost increase of a few percents
